clauses.quote: Homework assignments should be made on a reasonable and regular basis.
All assignments should have a clear educational purpose in support of the curriculum.
Homework should reinforce concepts discussed and taught in the classroom, as well as be a means of introducing new materials.
Assessments may inc1ude daily assignments. homework. tests. quizzes. and varied writing assignments. as well as portfolios. products. performances. research papers or other projects.
